examTags: 阅读·获取活动与组织信息
grammar: n. 俱乐部；社团。可数，复数 clubs；club 也可指体育俱乐部或夜总会，结合语境判断。
collocations: a school club; join a club; an art club。
commonMistake: club 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the 或物主限定词，如 a school club。

example.english: Our school has a club for young musicians.
example.chinese: 我们学校有一个面向年轻音乐爱好者的社团。

application.prompt: A group of students meets after school to paint together. They are in an art ___. A. club B. feeling
application.solution: A。解析：学生课后一起活动的社团是 club。

examTags: 语言运用·表达加入社团
grammar: v. 加入；参加。join—joined—joined；join + 人/组织，join in + 活动。
collocations: join a club; join the team; join in a game。
commonMistake: 说“加入社团”用 join a club；join in 后接活动，如 join in the game。

example.english: I want to join the school drama club.
example.chinese: 我想加入学校戏剧社。

application.prompt: Mia likes acting and wants to become a member of the drama club. She wants to ___ it. A. join B. join in
application.solution: A。解析：join 后直接接组织名称，join the drama club 表示加入戏剧社。

grammar: v. 选择；挑选。choose—chose—chosen；可接名词、疑问词 + to do 或 choose to do。
collocations: choose a club; choose between A and B; choose to paint。
commonMistake: choose 的过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen；不要把 chose 写成 choose。

example.english: She chose the music club last year.
example.chinese: 她去年选择了音乐社。

application.prompt: Yesterday, Ben ___ the climbing club. A. chose B. choose
application.solution: A。解析：yesterday 表示过去，choose 的过去式是 chose。

grammar: n. 戏剧；戏剧艺术。表示学科或表演活动时常作不可数名词；一部戏剧作品也可作可数名词。
collocations: drama club; a drama lesson; perform a drama。
commonMistake: drama 常与 club、lesson 等名词搭配；表示参加戏剧社说 join the drama club。

example.english: The drama club is preparing a play for Friday.
example.chinese: 戏剧社正在为周五准备一出戏。

application.prompt: Students in this club practise acting in plays. It is the ___ club. A. drama B. chess
application.solution: A。解析：练习戏剧表演的社团是 drama club。

grammar: n. 感觉；感情；可数，复数 feelings。由动词 feel + -ing 构成；feel 是动词“感觉、觉得”。
collocations: a happy feeling; feelings about music; have a feeling that ...。
commonMistake: feeling 是名词，feel 是动词；表示一种感觉可说 a feeling，不能漏掉冠词。

example.english: I have a good feeling about the school musical.
example.chinese: 我对学校音乐剧有种很好的预感。

application.prompt: After hearing the good news, Ella has a happy ___. A. feeling B. feel
application.solution: A。解析：a 后需要名词，feeling 是名词，表示“感觉”。

examTags: 语法·主谓一致与信息理解
grammar: n. 新闻；消息。通常不可数，形式以 -s 结尾但谓语用单数；一条消息可说 a piece of news。
collocations: good news; hear the news; a piece of news。
commonMistake: news 虽以 -s 结尾，通常仍用单数谓语：The news is good；不说 a news。

example.english: The news about the club is exciting.
example.chinese: 关于社团的消息令人兴奋。

application.prompt: The news about the art show ___ good. A. is B. are
application.solution: A。解析：news 通常作不可数名词，谓语用单数 is。

examTags: 词汇·名词与形容词辨析
grammar: n. 音乐剧；adj. 音乐的、有音乐才能的。作名词时可数，复数 musicals；作形容词可修饰 voice、instrument 等。
collocations: a school musical; musical instruments; musical talent。
commonMistake: musical 可作名词“音乐剧”，也可作形容词“音乐的”；注意 a musical 中它是名词。

example.english: Our drama club is putting on a musical this spring.
example.chinese: 今年春天，我们戏剧社要上演一部音乐剧。

application.prompt: The show tells a story with songs and dancing. It is a ___. A. musical B. drum
application.solution: A。解析：用歌曲和舞蹈讲故事的舞台作品可以是 musical（音乐剧）。

examTags: 词汇·副词与形容词辨析
grammar: adv. 恰好；正是；确切地。可修饰时间、数量或强调完全相同；形容词形式是 exact。
collocations: exactly at six; exactly the same; that's exactly right。
commonMistake: exactly 是副词，常修饰数字或时间；exact 是形容词，如 the exact time。

example.english: The club meeting starts at exactly four.
example.chinese: 社团活动恰好四点开始。

application.prompt: The clock shows 4:00, not 3:59 or 4:01. The meeting starts at ___ 4:00. A. exactly B. exact
application.solution: A。解析：修饰时间 4:00 要用副词 exactly；exact 是形容词。

examTags: 语言运用·介绍音乐活动
grammar: n. 鼓；可数，复数 drums。演奏鼓时常说 play the drums；一只鼓可说 a drum。
collocations: play the drums; a drum kit; beat a drum。
commonMistake: 表达演奏鼓类乐器常说 play the drums；表示一个鼓时用 a drum。

example.english: Leo plays the drums in the school band.
example.chinese: Leo 在学校乐队里打鼓。

application.prompt: The musician hits this instrument to make a strong beat. It is a ___. A. drum B. feeling
application.solution: A。解析：通过敲击发出节奏声的乐器是 drum（鼓）。

grammar: n. 能力；可数或不可数。常用 ability to do sth.；复数 abilities。
collocations: the ability to sing; reading ability; develop an ability。
commonMistake: 常说 the ability to do something，不说 the ability of do；ability 的复数为 abilities。

example.english: Mia has the ability to learn songs quickly.
example.chinese: Mia 有快速学会歌曲的能力。

application.prompt: Ben can paint very well. He has the ___ to make beautiful pictures. A. ability B. news
application.solution: A。解析：做某事的能力可以说 the ability to do it。

examTags: 语言运用·描述艺术活动
grammar: v. 用颜料画；给……刷漆；paint—painted—painted—painting。也可作 n. 颜料，通常不可数。
collocations: paint a picture; paint the wall; paint with watercolours。
commonMistake: paint 作动词时可直接接宾语：paint a picture；作名词表示颜料时通常不可数。

example.english: We paint pictures of flowers in the art club.
example.chinese: 我们在美术社画花的图画。

application.prompt: The art club wants to ___ a poster for its show. A. paint B. paints
application.solution: A。解析：to 后接动词原形，使用 paint。

grammar: v. 攀登；爬；climb—climbed—climbed—climbing。也可作 n. 攀登；常用 climb a hill/tree 或 go climbing。
collocations: climb a mountain; climb up a tree; go climbing。
commonMistake: climb 的 b 不发音；表示爬树常说 climb a tree，后面通常不再加 up。

example.english: The club members climb the hill together.
example.chinese: 社团成员们一起爬山。

application.prompt: The hill is not very high, so we can ___ it before lunch. A. climb B. drum
application.solution: A。解析：爬上小山用动词 climb。

examTags: 阅读·理解增加或比较信息
grammar: det./pron./adv. 更多；更。可修饰复数可数名词或不可数名词；也用于比较级，如 more exciting。
collocations: more time; more activities; more than one; more interesting。
commonMistake: more 可修饰 more books 或 more time；most 常表示三者及以上中的“最多/最……”。

example.english: I need more time to practise the drum.
example.chinese: 我需要更多时间练鼓。

application.prompt: The club has only ten minutes left, but we need ___ time to finish. A. more B. most
application.solution: A。解析：这里表示需要“更多”时间，用 more；most 表示“最多”。

examTags: 词汇·动词搭配与派生词
语言运用·描述戏剧表演
grammar: v. 表演；行动；表现。act—acted—acted—acting；可说 act in a play 或 act as ...；名词 actor 表示演员。
collocations: act in a play; act as a guide; act well。
commonMistake: 表示“在戏剧中表演”说 act in a play；act 是动词，演员是 actor。

example.english: Two students act in the drama club's new play.
example.chinese: 两名学生在戏剧社的新戏中表演。

application.prompt: Students in the drama club ___ in a play on Friday. A. act B. acts
application.solution: A。解析：主语 students 是复数，一般现在时用动词原形 act。

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与介词搭配
grammar: 形容词，描述某人对事物感兴趣；常用 be interested in + 名词或动词-ing。
collocations: be interested in nature；interested in collecting；become interested in
commonMistake: interested 描述感兴趣的人；interesting 通常描述让人感兴趣的事物。

example.english: Nina is interested in learning about insects.
example.chinese: 妮娜对了解昆虫感兴趣。

application.prompt: Leo loves learning about animals. He is ___ in wildlife. (interested / interesting)
application.solution: interested

examTags: 阅读能力·自然主题词汇
grammar: 名词，表示自然界或自然；泛指自然时通常作不可数名词。
collocations: nature club；in nature；nature reserve；enjoy nature
commonMistake: 泛指自然界时通常说 nature，不在前面加 a；a nature 通常不能表示“自然界”。

example.english: Our club walks in nature and watches birds.
example.chinese: 我们社团在大自然中徒步并观察鸟类。

application.prompt: Plants, animals, and the world around us are part of ___.
application.solution: nature

grammar: 名词，表示牛肉，通常作不可数名词；说明份量时可用 some beef 或 a piece of beef。
collocations: beef soup；beef noodles；a piece of beef
commonMistake: 泛指牛肉时通常不加 a，也不加复数 -s；可说 some beef。

example.english: Dad cooks beef with carrots for dinner.
example.chinese: 爸爸晚饭做胡萝卜炖牛肉。

application.prompt: We need some ___ for the stew. (beef)
application.solution: beef

grammar: 副词，表示不久、很快；常放在动词后或句末，也可用于 as soon as。
collocations: see you soon；soon after；as soon as；come back soon
commonMistake: soon 表示时间上“不久”；quickly 通常表示动作速度快。

example.english: Our nature club will meet again soon.
example.chinese: 我们的自然社团很快会再次活动。

application.prompt: It is 2:55, and the club meeting begins at 3:00. It starts ___.
application.solution: soon

grammar: 连词或介词，用于比较；常跟在比较级后，如 taller than 或 more interesting than。
collocations: bigger than；more than；better than；rather than
commonMistake: than 用于比较；then 常表示“然后/那时”，两者拼写相近但用法不同。

example.english: A whale is much bigger than a fish.
example.chinese: 鲸鱼比鱼大得多。

application.prompt: A nature walk is longer ___ our usual club meeting. (than / then)
application.solution: than

grammar: 可作名词，表示头脑或想法；也可作动词，表示介意。mind 后接动词时常用动词-ing；Would you mind...? 可用于礼貌请求。
collocations: change your mind；keep in mind；mind doing sth；Would you mind...?
commonMistake: mind 后接另一动作时常用动词-ing，如 I don't mind helping；不说 mind to help。

example.english: I don't mind helping the nature club collect leaves.
example.chinese: 我不介意帮自然社团收集树叶。

application.prompt: Would you mind ___ the box while I open the door? (hold)
application.solution: holding

grammar: 可作动词，表示落下或跌倒，不规则变化为 fall—fell—fallen；在美式英语中也可作名词表示秋天，英式英语常说 autumn。
collocations: leaves fall；fall down；fall asleep；in the fall (US)
commonMistake: fall 作动词的过去式是 fell、过去分词是 fallen；表示季节时 fall 是美式用法，autumn 也常用。

example.english: In the fall, leaves turn red and fall from the trees.
example.chinese: 秋天，树叶变红并从树上落下。

application.prompt: In the US, the season after summer is often called ___. (fall / fallen)
application.solution: fall

grammar: 动词，表示收集或采集；规则变化为 collect—collected—collected。
collocations: collect stamps；collect leaves；collect information
commonMistake: collect 表示收集，collection 是名词“收藏品/收集”；不要把两种词性混用。

example.english: The club collects fallen leaves for a science project.
example.chinese: 社团为一个科学项目收集落叶。

application.prompt: Every Saturday, we ___ leaves for our nature display. (collect)
application.solution: collect

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
grammar: 可数名词，表示昆虫；复数为 insects。以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。
collocations: an insect；insect life；insect collection
commonMistake: insect 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。

example.english: A butterfly is an insect with six legs.
example.chinese: 蝴蝶是一种有六条腿的昆虫。

application.prompt: An ant has six legs, so it is an ___.
application.solution: insect

examTags: 阅读能力·理解发现与探索
grammar: 动词，表示发现或了解到；规则变化为 discover—discovered—discovered；可接名词或 that 从句。
collocations: discover a new place；discover a fact；discover that...
commonMistake: discover 表示发现原先未知的事物；其名词形式 discovery 的复数为 discoveries。

example.english: The students discovered a small pond behind the nature centre.
example.chinese: 学生们在自然中心后面发现了一个小池塘。

application.prompt: Yesterday, our club found a new bird near the lake. We ___ it there. (discover)
application.solution: discovered

examTags: 阅读能力·自然环境与动物
grammar: 名词，泛指自然环境中的野生动物和植物时通常作不可数名词。
collocations: protect wildlife；wildlife park；wildlife around the world
commonMistake: 泛指野生生物时通常用 wildlife，不加复数 -s；具体动物可用 wild animals。

example.english: The nature club learns how to protect local wildlife.
example.chinese: 自然社团学习如何保护当地野生生物。

application.prompt: The animals and plants that live in nature are known as ___.
application.solution: wildlife

examTags: 语言运用·音乐与社团活动
grammar: 动词，表示唱歌；不规则变化为 sing—sang—sung，第三人称单数为 sings。
collocations: sing a song；sing along；sing in a choir
commonMistake: sing 的过去式是 sang，过去分词是 sung；不要把两种形式混淆。

example.english: The music club sings a new song every month.
example.chinese: 音乐社每个月唱一首新歌。

application.prompt: Our club ___ folk songs at the spring show. (sing)
application.solution: sings

grammar: 动词，表示游泳；不规则变化为 swim—swam—swum；进行时 swimming 要双写 m。
collocations: swim in a pool；go swimming；swimming lesson
commonMistake: swim 的过去式是 swam；现在分词 swimming 要双写 m。

example.english: We swim in the school pool after lessons on Friday.
example.chinese: 周五放学后，我们在学校泳池游泳。

application.prompt: Jake ___ in the pool every Tuesday. (swim)
application.solution: swims

examTags: 语言运用·运动与日常活动
grammar: 动词，表示跑；不规则变化为 run—ran—run；现在分词 running 要双写 n。
collocations: run fast；run around；run a race；go for a run
commonMistake: run 的过去式是 ran；running 要双写 n，不能写成 runing。

example.english: I run around the field with my friends after school.
example.chinese: 放学后我和朋友在操场上跑步。

application.prompt: At the sports club, we ___ around the field each week. (run)
application.solution: run

examTags: 语法知识·形容词和副词同形
grammar: adj./adv. 快的；快速地。fast 作形容词和副词时形式相同，比较级 faster，最高级 fastest。
collocations: a fast train；run fast；fast food
commonMistake: fast 作副词时不加 -ly：run fast；quick 的副词形式是 quickly。

example.english: The blue train is fast, but the red one is faster.
example.chinese: 蓝色的火车很快，但红色的那辆更快。

application.prompt: This train can travel at high speed. It is a ___ train. (fast / quickly)
application.solution: fast。解析：train 前需要形容词；fast 是形容词，quickly 是副词。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: fast, quick or quickly

examTags: 语言运用·兴趣与社团活动
grammar: v. 跳舞；n. 舞蹈。作动词时规则变化为 dance—danced—danced；dance to music 表示随着音乐跳舞。
collocations: dance to music；dance with a partner；a dance club
commonMistake: 表示“随着音乐跳舞”用 dance to music；dance 的过去式为 danced。

example.english: Mia likes to dance to music after school.
example.chinese: 米娅喜欢放学后随着音乐跳舞。

application.prompt: Mia likes to ___ to music after school. (dance / dances)
application.solution: dance。解析：like to 后接动词原形。

grammar: v. 飞；放飞。作动词时不规则变化为 fly—flew—flown；fly a kite 表示放风筝。
collocations: birds fly；fly a kite；fly to another city
commonMistake: fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown；不要写成 flied。

example.english: Yesterday, our kite flew over the school field.
example.chinese: 昨天，我们的风筝飞过了学校操场。

application.prompt: Yesterday, the kite ___ above the field. (flew / flown)
application.solution: flew。解析：Yesterday 表示过去，fly 的过去式是 flew。

examTags: 语法知识·动词与名词辨析
语言运用·描述观看活动
grammar: v. 观看；注视；n. 手表。作动词时规则变化为 watch—watched—watched；watch 后直接接观看的内容。
collocations: watch TV；watch a film；watch a game；a wristwatch
commonMistake: 表示观看节目时说 watch TV，不在 watch 后加 to；名词 watch 表示“手表”。

example.english: We watch the club show together every Friday.
example.chinese: 我们每周五一起观看社团演出。

application.prompt: We ___ the club show together every Friday. (watch / watches)
application.solution: watch。解析：主语 We 是复数人称，谓语用动词原形。

examTags: 语法知识·可数与不可数名词
语言运用·食物与份量表达
grammar: n. 蛋糕。表示一个完整的蛋糕时可数，如 a cake；泛指蛋糕或一份时可作不可数用法，如 a piece of cake。
collocations: a birthday cake；a piece of cake；make a cake
commonMistake: piece of 后接 cake，不说 a piece of cakes；表示完整的一个蛋糕可说 a cake。

example.english: I would like a piece of cake after lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭后我想吃一块蛋糕。

application.prompt: I would like a piece of ___ after lunch. (cake / cakes)
application.solution: cake。解析：piece of 后接表示食物整体的 cake。

examTags: 语法知识·情态动词后接动词原形
grammar: v. 烹饪；煮。规则变化为 cook—cooked—cooked；cook 也可作可数名词，表示厨师。
collocations: cook dinner；cook noodles；a good cook
commonMistake: can 后接动词原形：can cook；不能写成 can cooks。

example.english: My brother can cook noodles for the club.
example.chinese: 我哥哥会为社团煮面条。

application.prompt: My brother can ___ noodles for the club. (cook / cooks)
application.solution: cook。解析：情态动词 can 后用动词原形。

examTags: 语言运用·食物与份量表达
grammar: n. 面条；常以复数 noodles 表示一份面条或面食；单数 noodle 可指一根面条。
collocations: a bowl of noodles；noodle soup；cook noodles
commonMistake: 说一碗面通常用 a bowl of noodles；noodles 以 -s 结尾，但这里表示食物，不是多个完整份数。

example.english: We shared two bowls of noodles after the dance class.
example.chinese: 舞蹈课后我们分吃了两碗面条。

application.prompt: We ordered two bowls of ___ for lunch. (noodle / noodles)
application.solution: noodles。解析：表示面食通常用复数 noodles。

examTags: 语法知识·动词与形容词
grammar: v. 打开；adj. 开着的、开放的。动词过去式和过去分词为 opened；形容词 open 描述未关闭的状态。
collocations: open the door；open a window；be open
commonMistake: open 作动词表示“打开”，opened 是过去式；open 作形容词表示“开着的”，如 The door is open。

example.english: Please open the window before the club meeting.
example.chinese: 社团活动开始前请打开窗户。

application.prompt: Please ___ the window before the club meeting. (open / opens)
application.solution: open。解析：祈使句以动词原形开头。

examTags: 词汇搭配·动词与名词搭配
grammar: v. 拿；带；参加等。不规则变化为 take—took—taken；常见结构有 take part in sth.（参加某活动）。
collocations: take part in；take a photo；take a bus；take a break
commonMistake: 固定搭配是 take part in；take 的过去式是 took，过去分词是 taken。

example.english: Our club will take part in the school art show.
example.chinese: 我们社团将参加学校艺术展。

application.prompt: Our club will ___ part in the school art show. (take / make)
application.solution: take。解析：表示“参加”用 take part in。

examTags: 语言运用·描述参观与拜访
grammar: v. 参观；拜访。visit 后直接接地点或人作宾语；规则变化为 visit—visited—visited。
collocations: visit a museum；visit a friend；visit a city
commonMistake: 动词 visit 后直接接地点或人，不说 visit to a place；名词短语可说 pay a visit to a place。

example.english: We will visit the science museum on Saturday.
example.chinese: 我们周六将参观科学博物馆。

application.prompt: On Saturday, we will ___ the science museum. (visit / go)
application.solution: visit。解析：visit 可直接接地点作宾语；go 后通常需用 to 再接地点。

grammar: n. 公园；停车场。作可数名词，单数前通常需有冠词或限定词，复数为 parks；也可作动词表示停车。
collocations: in the park；go to a park；a city park
commonMistake: 表示“在公园里”说 in the park；park 也可作动词“停车”，需结合上下文判断词性。

example.english: The club has a picnic in the park every spring.
example.chinese: 社团每年春天都在公园里野餐。

application.prompt: The children play outside in the ___ near their school. (park / classroom)
application.solution: park。解析：学校附近供户外活动的地点是公园。

examTags: 语法知识·时间状语从句
grammar: adv./conj. 什么时候；当……时。疑问句中询问时间；作连词时引导时间状语从句，表示“当……时”。
collocations: when to start；when the class begins；since when
commonMistake: when 询问时间，where 询问地点；谈将来时，when 从句中通常用一般现在时表示将来。

example.english: When does the dance club meet? It meets on Friday.
example.chinese: 舞蹈社团什么时候活动？周五活动。

application.prompt: ___ does the dance club meet? — On Friday. (When / Where)
application.solution: When。解析：回答是 On Friday，表示时间，因此询问时间用 When。

grammar: v. 分享；共用；分配。规则变化为 share—shared—shared；表示与某人分享某物，常用 share sth. with sb.。
collocations: share sth. with sb.；share a room；share ideas
commonMistake: 表示“和某人分享某物”用 share sth. with sb.，不用 share sth. to sb.。

example.english: I like to share my ideas with the club members.
example.chinese: 我喜欢和社团成员分享我的想法。

application.prompt: Please share the cake ___ your friends. (with / to)
application.solution: with。解析：固定搭配为 share sth. with sb.。
